info.title: Tax Workbench local agent API
info.description: Native calculations, original-layout previews, offline SOAP validation, revisioned inputs and durable filing receipts. Monetary values are decimal strings. Full parity remains unverified. Live CRA transmission is controlled by owner settings and defaults off. Trusted agents can perform all API operations within the user’s authorization. Final transmission still requires explicit confirmation. Agents must resolve issues and filingInputIssues, verify year-specific identity/residency/marital/spouse/dependant facts and source carryovers, then recalculate, inspect original checks and pass offline validation with no financial differences or inactive inputs. Unknown is not No or zero. Authorized agents may review; transmit only when the user requests it.

post.summary: Create or edit a structured slip
post.description: Box values are decimal strings. T4 16A/17A require 2024+. T4A COVID197/202 use2020+; T4E37 uses2020+ (36 in2019), and rate7 is explicit. Other boxes use exact native fields. T5013 supports every monetary/descriptive box in the year-specific GET slips t5013Catalog. Values use original fields; text115 may be in boxes or textBoxes. Optional boxes accept null to clear;116/118 cannot be cleared. Business box116 requires118. Gross income is required from the corrected issued slip, with no missing/null/blank substitution; requires partnershipNumber,fiscalEnd,issued partnerCode0–6,sourceReference,issuedSlipConfirmed=true. Business income also requires allocationPercentage,industryCode,accountingMethod. Only active code2 business slips can replace linked business books. Link the existing partnership business to prevent double counting; original source records remain saved. This imports a slip into a T1 and does not file a T5013-FIN or slips/summary return.

118.description: T5013 active-business gross income is required from the corrected issued slip. No null, blank or invented zero. A partial patch can omit this property only when its existing value is retained.

allocationPercentage.description: Box005 share of net income/loss,0–100, at most two meaningful decimal places; not legal ownership.

accountingMethod.description: Original T5013 codes:1 accrual,2 cash. Earlier Workbench labels were reversed; verify existing inputs against the source.

linkedBusinessId.description: Existing partnership business replaced by this slip. Books and agreement remain saved but are excluded from this personal calculation and export.

issuedSlipConfirmed.description: Explicit confirmation of an actual issued slip; never infer from an allocation agreement.

textBoxes.description: All original descriptive boxes, including115. Box105 has both numeric and text forms; use textBoxes105 for its description.

covidAssistance.description: Explicit portion of box114 that is COVID assistance. Required for nonzero114 when the yearly model supports it;0 means ordinary other income. Never inferred from115.

post.summary: Create or partially edit original business inputs
post.description: Full named input categories and original CCA codes are in business-mappings/{year}. New records require name/type/ownership/accounting/fiscal dates. No net or total-CCA override. Use allocation with explicit agreed profit/loss percentages when different from legal ownership. Null removes this Workbench extension. Ownership remains unchanged in previews and SOAP. For a synthetic unequal-allocation example: ownership50,profit50,loss99.9 from2021 onward. Find the actual business ID, preserve other businesses, and recalculate. Profit years remain50%; never force ownership100 or override net income. Inspect calculation.result.allocationAdjustments; human review and filing remain separate.

homeOfficeClaim.description: Already apportioned business-use costs, mutually exclusive with whole-home costs. False eligibility remains provisional. An explicit scoped owner decision can acknowledge a selected position while retaining the unverified metadata; otherwise review/filing is blocked.

inventoryAccounting.description: Explicit signed cost-of-goods accounting for an accrual business. Preserve original stock/cost inputs; never invent other income to compensate for a stock movement.

enhancedCca2024.description: 2024 class50 qualifying original additions only. Explicit dates and restrictions; false eligibility remains a source issue unless an explicit scoped owner decision acknowledges the selected position.
